articles.title: Senate Democrats call for hearings into Trump’s ties to crypto amid CLARITY Act discussions
articles.snippet: Five senators called for committee hearings to investigate US President Donald Trump’s policies potentially being influenced by crypto funding from United Arab Emirates-linked and other entities.

articles.title: Apple Sues OpenAI, Claims Former Employees Stole Trade Secrets
articles.snippet: Apple alleges former employees took confidential designs, supplier information, and engineering files before joining OpenAI.

articles.title: Democrats Call for Senate Hearings on Trump's Massive Crypto Profits
articles.snippet: Top Democrats on key Senate committees demanded inquiries into the more than $1.2 billion that President Trump made on crypto last year.

articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.6 Sol: Here’s How It Stacks Up Against Other AI Models
articles.snippet: OpenAI's new flagship model is out, after spending two weeks locked behind a government-approved preview. It lands the same week Fable 5 leaves Anthropic's subscription plans.

articles.title: The New Grok 4.5 Is Out. Elon Musk Says It Competes With Last Year's Claude Opus
articles.snippet: SpaceXAI's new coding model is cheaper and faster than Anthropic and OpenAI's flagships—and by Musk's own account, at least one generation behind them.
